page.layout: One printed page, title page. Large spaced capitals at the top, then smaller lines of title text in decreasing sizes, a central woodcut or ornament with faint lines below it, and a few small lines near the foot. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: The page is a title page, so every line is an <l>. The large lines DAVIDIS and PSALTERIVM are legible; the word PSALTERIVM is partly in spaced capitals and its exact spelling is marked as read. The smaller title lines are faint and blurred, and I could not read them letter by letter, so they are marked illegible with approximate letter counts.
